# Blockly 12.5.1 (vendored)

Unmodified files from the npm package `blockly@12.5.1`
(tarball integrity `sha512-etXLpUtEkcRibHGwIJ4BsvnIzMJJs0C0yPIjE/W0NCtj8ACha/a7Q9n7Ib6+j7N4EzQ0p28YPZMnypi5pNIj1g==`):
`blockly_compressed.js`, `blocks_compressed.js`, `msg/de.js`, `msg/en.js`, `media/`.

Copyright Google LLC, licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (<https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0>).
Source: <https://github.com/google/blockly>.

Vendored (not loaded from a CDN) so the GUI keeps working offline. 12.x because that is the line
`scratch-blocks` 2.x builds on, should we switch to it later.

## @blockly/continuous-toolbox 7.0.9

`continuous-toolbox.js` is `dist/index.js` of the npm package `@blockly/continuous-toolbox@7.0.9`, unmodified
(integrity `sha512-luFNC9GX4GAEqTrag07jV3DrY2WEeYfyBJnP932/xb27hs6oVaAw1bJPzI/NtyBxdU3LOkQZ826fEVbCVoXzAQ==`),
Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE-continuous-toolbox`). The Scratch-style palette that stays open; scratch-blocks uses
the same plugin.
